paper.title_en: The astrometric precision of incoherent pulsar timing arrays
paper.abstract_en: We address the astrometric precision with which a pulsar timing array (PTA) can localize a single astrophysical gravitational-wave source, in the regime where pulsar distances are poorly constrained compared to the gravitational wavelength. Using simple matched-filter, map-making simulations, we calculate the astrometric precision of the intrinsic PTA residual response as a function of the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), where the SNR is that of the source in the matched-filter map, and find that the median angular error decreases as $\sqrt{\ln 2/3}\,/[\mathrm{SNR}\sqrt{\ln\mathrm{SNR}}]$ over the relevant SNR range, with a pre-factor we derive from first principles. At an SNR of 6, this log term coming from the singular core of the convolution kernel produces an angular error approximately $1.4$ times smaller than for a Gaussian beam. We compare this sky-averaged maximum precision with the precision achieved across the sky by the pulsars of the International Pulsar Timing Array (IPTA) DR2. For a map with SNR of 6, the intrinsic array precision is $3.3^\circ$. For the IPTA configuration at the same SNR, the median precision over the sky is worse due to sparse sampling of the underlying pulsar residual response, approximately $8.9^\circ$; however, for sources in $14\%$ of the sky, the high local pulsar density yields a precision better than $3.3^\circ$.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）对单个天体物理引力波源的天体测量定位精度，属于PTA主题的核心问题。文中给出了基于匹配滤波和映射模拟的角误差随信噪比的解析标度关系，并与IPTA DR2的实际脉冲星分布进行比较，理论推导与数值模拟结合，结果具体且可检验，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 非相干脉冲星计时阵列的天体测量精度
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）在脉冲星距离相对于引力波波长约束较差的情形下，对单个天体物理引力波源进行定位的天体测量精度。使用简单的匹配滤波、映射（map-making）模拟，我们计算了内禀PTA残差响应作为信噪比（SNR）函数的天体测量精度，其中SNR为源在匹配滤波图中的信噪比，并发现中位角误差在相关SNR范围内按 $\sqrt{\ln 2/3}\,/[\mathrm{SNR}\sqrt{\ln\mathrm{SNR}}]$ 减小，其前置因子由第一性原理导出。在SNR为6时，来自卷积核奇异核心的对数项使角误差比高斯束情形约小 $1.4$ 倍。我们将这一全天平均最大精度与国际脉冲星计时阵列（IPTA）DR2的脉冲星在全天所达到的精度进行比较。对于SNR为6的图，内禀阵列精度为 $3.3^\circ$。在相同SNR下，对IPTA的配置，由于对底层脉冲星残差响应采样稀疏，全天空中位精度较差，约为 $8.9^\circ$；然而，对于天空中 $14\%$ 区域的源，局部脉冲星密度高，精度优于 $3.3^\circ$。
